name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2024-02-08.11.1) introduced by Tasmanian Senator [Nick McKim](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/tasmania/nick_mckim) (Greens), which means it succeeded. ### Motion text > *At the end of the motion, add:* > > *"and, in respect of the [Administrative Review Tribunal Bill 2023, the Administrative Review Tribunal (Consequential and Transitional Provisions No. 1) Bill 2023 and the Administrative Review Tribunal (Consequential and Transitional Provisions No. 2) Bill 2024](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/bd/bd2324a/24bd054), the provisions of the bills be referred immediately to the Legal and Constitutional Affairs Legislation Committee for [inquiry and report by 24 July 2024](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Committees/Senate/Legal_and_Constitutional_Affairs/ARTBills2447)."*
